mapper.select:
SELECT t1.FRID AS frid , t1.FRGN AS frgn , t1.ENAM AS enam , t1.KNAM AS knam , t1.SYMB AS symb , t1.EXID AS exid , t1.MKCD AS mkcd , t1.MKID AS mkid FROM API_FRGNCODE t1
AND t1.FRID = #{frid}
AND ( UPPER(t1.FRGN) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(t1.ENAM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR t1.KNAM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR UPPER(t1.SYMB) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY t1.FRID ASC, t1.FRGN ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO API_FRGNCODE ( FRID, FRGN, ENAM, KNAM, SYMB, EXID, MKCD, MKID ) VALUES ( TRIM(#{frid}), TRIM(#{frgn}), TRIM(#{enam, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), TRIM(#{knam, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), TRIM(#{symb, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), TRIM(#{exid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), TRIM(#{mkcd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), TRIM(#{mkid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) )
mapper.update: UPDATE API_FRGNCODE SET ENAM = TRIM(#{enam, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), KNAM = TRIM(#{knam, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), SYMB = TRIM(#{symb, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), EXID = TRIM(#{exid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), MKCD = TRIM(#{mkcd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), MKID = TRIM(#{mkid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) WHERE FRID = #{frid} AND FRGN = #{frgn}
